verdict.rationale: Watchtower reviews every live interaction against custom natural-language criteria and flags issues such as policy violations or frustration. Duet and Suggestions close the loop by detecting gaps from conversations and iterating on the agent or knowledge content, while Simulations re-validate behavior with each update. Missing for 10: explicit QA scoring or scorecards on sampled conversations, a documented human review workflow tying flagged items to specific fixes, and independent or hands-on corroboration of these vendor claims.
